summary_1line: King Parikshit fortifies himself against Takshaka’s curse while the healer Kasyapa proves his power but accepts Takshaka’s bribe and turns back.

image_candidates.scene_text: Takshaka in serpent form bites a great banyan tree, which instantly bursts into flames and collapses into ashes before Kasyapa.
Kasyapa gathers the ashes of the burnt banyan and, chanting, restores it step by step until the full tree stands alive again.
High above the ground, King Parikshit sits in a guarded palace built on a single pillar, surrounded by priests, physicians, and watchful ministers.
